description:
Bycatch from the fz-kdt.105 adversarial review (2026-08-31, pre-existing
at fba7d72e3 and every head since). fz2 interp on Enum.drop_while([],
pred) dies 'backend value 1 is unbound'; 00277_enum_tier0_fixture aborts
identically at output line 13; JIT and AOT are correct and
byte-identical. Three-path-parity break.

MECHANISM (probe-verified 2026-09-01 at a010532e8, minimal repro
`dbg(Enum.drop_while([], fn (x) -> x > 0 end))`): the failing executable
is FunctionId(66) arrow Ty(41); its entry steps are
[List v2, Const v3, Tuple v4, Lambda{v5, fn 159, captures:[v1]}] and the
env at failure holds {v2,v3,v4} -- NO v0/v1. v1 is the predicate
closure input whose runtime demand is IGNORE (on the empty-list path
the closure is provably never invoked: canon shows
callable(resolved=[] targets=[] opaque=false escape=false)), so
bind_executable_inputs (ir_interp/backend.rs:1744) binds it None (empty
reprs = no lane) and the env never gets an entry -- but the body still
carries the Lambda CONSTRUCTION step, and the interp evaluates it
eagerly, faulting on the capture lookup (env_get_value,
ir_interp/backend.rs:1738). Native tolerates the same program (absent
values materialize lazily; jobs/native.rs:3507 errors only on real
use), hence the parity split.

FIX SHAPES TO WEIGH (builder decides with measurement):
(a) OMIT the dead construction -- the fresh-construction steps have an
Omitted fallback for provably-unread constructions
(construction_step_or_omitted); a Lambda whose value has resolved=[]
targets=[] escape=false and no downstream read should not be emitted.
Correct-by-construction; check why Lambda is outside that machinery.
(b) DEMAND-side closing sweep precedent: runtime_demand.rs:~2265's
TupleField starved-source sweep is the exact same crash class (fz-xvq
'materialize absent value'); a Lambda-capture sweep would keep captures
live whenever the Lambda step is emitted -- but that MATERIALIZES a
provably-dead closure (wrong direction if (a) is available).
(c) INTERP-side: bind demand-ignored inputs as an explicit Absent
binding so construction steps can carry absent captures the way native
does -- parity by imitation, keeps the dead step.
Prefer (a) if the omission machinery reaches Lambda cleanly; (c) is the
fallback that fixes parity without touching demand.

RELATED: fz-kdt.3's two live repros (ignored
compiler2_jit_and_backend_interp_agree_on_reusable_cons_exit_counters
lib test + enum_tier0 matrix deferral) carry the same signature --
verify against the fix and fold fz-kdt.3 if it closes them.
title: Interp backend dies 'backend value N is unbound' on drop_while over empty list; 00277 aborts at line 13 -- JIT/AOT correct (pre-existing three-path-parity bug)
